07.action: The raised palms hold and breathe: the fingers sway by a hair as if in a faint draft, the palms tilt a degree forward and back with a slow inhale and exhale, the deep palm creases flex, and the stipple grain at the wrists shimmers. Locked camera, fixed frontal light.

Both hands slowly close into fists, finger by finger from the little finger inward, the thumbs folding over last; the fists hold for a beat, then open again in the reverse order, fingers spreading wide until both palms face the viewer in the exact starting pose. One smooth cycle. Locked camera, frontal light.
07.audio: Sound: a soft rustle of fingers closing and opening.

07.action: After a short hold both hands sink straight down along their wrists, fingers still spread, and slide out of the bottom of the frame until only clean black remains. Locked camera, steady frontal light.
07.audio: Sound: a low hum that fades to silence.

07.action: The engraved dots of both hands loosen from the fingertips downward, the fingers thinning into columns of drifting white specks that lift upward like sparks, then the drift reverses and the specks fall back into place, rebuilding fingers, palms and creases until both open hands stand whole in the exact starting pose. Locked camera.
07.audio: Sound: dry grains hissing, then settling.

07.action: The camera pushes in slowly toward the centre gap between the two palms, the palm creases and finger joints growing large and crisp, the outer fingers sliding past the frame edges, until the two palms fill the frame. The hands hold still. Fixed frontal light.

The camera arcs slowly around the pair of raised hands, a thirty-degree orbit from front toward the left, revealing the thickness of the palms and the spread of the fingers in perspective, while the hands stay perfectly still. Frontal light, black void.

A hard white light travels from the left edge to the right: the left palm flares bright, the highlight rolls across its fingers, crosses the gap, and the right palm ignites while the left sinks back into grey stipple, then the light drifts back to its even frontal position. Hands hold still. Locked camera.
07.audio: Sound: a slow electric hum sliding in pitch.

07.action: The fingers fold down one at a time in a slow countdown, little finger first, alternating between the two hands, until both hands are closed fists; the fists hold, then both open at once with a quick spread and push toward the camera as if to say stop, and hold there. Locked camera, frontal light.
07.audio: Sound: soft ticks for each folding finger, then a firm whoosh.

07.action: Both hands rotate slowly around their wrists to show their backs, knuckles and tendons turning to face the viewer, hold for a beat, then rotate back until the palms face forward again in the exact starting pose. Fingers stay spread throughout. Locked camera, frontal light.
07.audio: Sound: a soft rub of skin.

07.action: The two hands slide outward to the left and right edges of the frame, fingers still spread and palms still facing the viewer, until each hand is half out of frame, leaving the whole centre as clean empty black for a title, and hold. Locked camera, frontal light.
07.audio: Sound: a soft low room tone.

08.action: The two thumbs-up hold and breathe: the thumbs tilt by a degree and straighten, the fists tighten and relax, the bright rims on the thumbs flicker as they move, and the stipple grain on the forearms shimmers. Locked camera, fixed top-front light.

Both thumbs slowly fold down into the fists and the fists open into relaxed flat hands, palms toward the viewer, pause, then close back into fists and the thumbs pop up straight again, landing in the exact starting pose with the left high and the right low. One smooth cycle. Locked camera, top-front light.
08.audio: Sound: a soft rustle and two small pops.

08.action: After a short hold the left fist slides back toward the left edge and the right fist sinks toward the lower-right corner, thumbs still raised, until both leave the frame and only clean black remains. Locked camera, steady light.
08.audio: Sound: a low hum that fades to silence.

08.action: The engraved dots of both fists loosen and lift away, the thumbs thinning into columns of drifting white specks that rise like smoke, then the drift reverses and the specks fall back into knuckles, thumbnails and forearms until both thumbs-up stand whole in their exact starting pose. Locked camera.
08.audio: Sound: dry grains hissing, then settling.

08.action: The camera pushes in slowly toward the larger left fist, its raised thumb and knuckle ridges growing large and crisp, the deep engraved folds filling the frame, the right fist sliding out past the lower edge. The hands hold still. Fixed top-front light.

The camera arcs slowly around the two fists, a thirty-degree orbit from front toward the right, revealing the depth of the fists and the thumbs standing in perspective, while the hands stay still. Top-front light, black void.

A hard white light travels from the upper-left corner to the lower-right: the left thumb flares first, the highlight rolls down its fist, crosses the gap, and the right thumb and fist ignite while the left sinks back into grey stipple, then the light returns to its starting position. Hands hold still. Locked camera.
08.audio: Sound: a slow electric hum sliding in pitch.

08.action: Both fists rotate a full half turn so the thumbs point straight down, hold the thumbs-down for a beat, then the two fists swing toward each other and bump knuckles at the centre with a small burst of white dots, and finally turn back up into a double thumbs-up. Locked camera, top-front light.
08.audio: Sound: a low creak of rotation, then a dry knuckle thud.

08.action: The two fists trade places, the left fist sinking and sliding right while the right fist rises and slides left, crossing at the centre, then they cross back and settle in the exact starting positions with the left high and the right low. Thumbs stay raised throughout. Locked camera, top-front light.
08.audio: Sound: a soft whoosh as they cross.

08.action: Both fists slide down toward the bottom of the frame, thumbs still raised, and come to rest low at the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, leaving the upper two-thirds of the frame as clean empty black for a title, and hold. Locked camera, top-front light.
08.audio: Sound: a soft low room tone.

09.action: The fists hold their contact and breathe: the knuckles press and ease by a millimetre, the forearms tense and relax, small highlights flicker along the knuckle ridges, and the heavy stipple grain on the forearms shimmers. Locked camera, fixed top light.
09.audio: Sound: a faint room tone with a soft creak of knuckles.

09.action: The fists slowly pull apart to the sides, open into relaxed flat hands hanging from the wrists, pause, then close back into fists and swing together until the knuckles meet at the centre in the exact starting pose. One smooth cycle. Locked camera, top light.
09.audio: Sound: a soft rustle, then a dry knuckle tap.

09.action: After a short hold the fists separate and each slides back along its forearm toward its own edge of the frame, the left to the left and the right to the right, until both leave the frame and only clean black remains. Locked camera, steady top light.
09.audio: Sound: a low hum that fades to silence.

09.action: The coarse engraved grain of the forearms loosens first, then both fists dissolve into a cloud of drifting white specks that swirl around the contact point at the centre, then the swirl tightens and the specks pour back into knuckles and forearms until the two fists press together again in the exact starting pose. Locked camera.
09.audio: Sound: dry grains hissing, then settling.

09.action: The camera pushes in slowly toward the seam where the knuckles meet, the ridges of both fists growing large and crisp, the coarse dot grain of the forearms sliding out past the frame edges, until the contact point fills the frame. The fists hold still. Fixed top light.

The camera arcs slowly around the two fists, a thirty-degree orbit from above-front toward the left, revealing the depth of the knuckles and the length of the forearms in perspective, while the fists stay pressed together. Top light, black void.

A hard white light sweeps from the left edge to the right: the left forearm flares, the highlight rolls along it onto the left fist, crosses the seam to the right fist and travels down the right forearm, then the light drifts back to its starting position overhead. The fists hold still. Locked camera.
09.audio: Sound: a slow electric hum sliding in pitch.

09.action: The fists draw back apart, pause, then swing together and collide at the centre with a burst of white dots exploding from the impact; the fists hold pressed together, then both open at once into spread fingers that fly apart like an explosion, and the open hands settle wide. Locked camera, top light plus the flash of the burst.
09.audio: Sound: a dry heavy knuckle thud with a short burst, then a whoosh.

09.action: The two fists twist against each other, rotating in opposite directions around the contact point so the thumbs roll over the top and back, grinding knuckle on knuckle, then twist back the other way and settle in the exact starting pose. Locked camera, top light.
09.audio: Sound: a low grind of skin on skin.

09.action: The fists sink together toward the bottom of the frame, still pressed knuckle to knuckle, the forearms sloping down to the lower corners, and come to rest low in the frame, leaving the upper two-thirds as clean empty black for a title. Locked camera, top light.
09.audio: Sound: a soft low room tone.

10.action: The two V signs hold and breathe: the raised fingers sway by a hair and the V widens and narrows a degree, the folded fingers tighten, bright rims on the fingers flicker, and the stipple grain at the wrists shimmers. Locked camera, fixed frontal light.

The raised fingers slowly fold down into fists, the fists relax and lower slightly, pause, then lift again and the index and middle fingers spring back up into the V, landing in the exact starting pose with the left hand high and the right hand low. One smooth cycle. Locked camera, frontal light.
10.audio: Sound: a soft rustle and two small pops.

10.action: After a short hold both hands sink straight down along their forearms, fingers still raised in the V, and slide out of the bottom of the frame until only clean black remains. Locked camera, steady frontal light.
10.audio: Sound: a low hum that fades to silence.

10.action: The engraved dots of both hands loosen from the fingertips down, the V fingers thinning into pairs of drifting white streaks that lift upward, then the drift reverses and the specks fall back into fingers, knuckles and palms until both V signs stand whole in their exact starting pose. Locked camera.
10.audio: Sound: dry grains hissing, then settling.

10.action: The camera pushes in slowly toward the left hand's raised fingers, the V growing large and crisp with its etched knuckle creases and bright nails, the right hand sliding out past the frame edge. The hands hold still. Fixed frontal light.

The camera arcs slowly around the two hands, a thirty-degree orbit from front toward the left, revealing the thickness of the palms and the raised fingers in perspective, while the hands stay perfectly still. Frontal light, black void.

A hard white light travels from the upper-left corner to the lower-right: the left hand's V flares first, the highlight rolls down its fingers and palm, crosses the gap, and the right hand ignites while the left sinks back into grey stipple, then the light returns to its even frontal position. Hands hold still. Locked camera.
10.audio: Sound: a slow electric hum sliding in pitch.

10.action: The raised fingers of both hands scissor open and closed twice, then the left hand folds its middle finger down and its thumb springs up into a thumbs-up while the right hand keeps the V, they hold, then both hands wave once side to side and settle. Locked camera, frontal light.
10.audio: Sound: soft snips, a small pop, then a whoosh.

10.action: The two hands drift toward each other and cross, the right hand passing in front of the left so the two V signs overlap into a crossed X of four fingers at the centre, hold the crossing for a beat, then slide back apart into the exact starting pose. Locked camera, frontal light.
10.audio: Sound: a soft whoosh as the hands cross.

10.action: Both hands slide outward to the left and right edges of the frame, fingers still raised in the V, until each hand is half out of frame, leaving the whole centre as clean empty black for a title, and hold. Locked camera, frontal light.
10.audio: Sound: a soft low room tone.

11.action: The finger frame holds and breathes: the index fingers and thumbs flex by a hair so the rectangle widens and narrows a millimetre, tendons ripple on the backs of the hands, and the stipple grain on the forearms shimmers. Locked camera, fixed top light.

The hands slowly relax, the index fingers curling and the thumbs folding so the frame collapses into two loose fists that drift apart, pause, then the fingers extend again, the hands slide back together and the thumbs and index fingers lock into the exact rectangular frame they started with. One smooth cycle. Locked camera, top light.
11.audio: Sound: a soft rustle and a light tap as the frame locks.

11.action: After a short hold the frame breaks apart, the left hand sliding back toward the lower-left corner and the right hand toward the upper-right corner along their forearms, until both leave the frame and only clean black remains. Locked camera, steady top light.
11.audio: Sound: a low hum that fades to silence.

11.action: The engraved dots of both hands loosen and drift apart, the frame's edges thinning into scattered white specks that hover around the empty rectangle, then the specks stream back and stack into thumbs, index fingers and knuckles until the finger frame stands whole in its exact starting pose. Locked camera.
11.audio: Sound: dry grains hissing, then settling.

11.action: The camera pushes in slowly and steadily toward the empty black rectangle between the fingers, the frame growing until the index fingers and thumbs slide out past the edges of the shot and the camera passes through into pure black. Fixed top light, the hands hold still.
11.audio: Sound: a deep quiet drone rising slightly.

11.action: The camera arcs slowly around the finger frame, a thirty-degree orbit from front toward the right, the rectangle skewing into perspective as the fingers reveal their length and the hands their depth, while the hands stay still. Top light, black void.

A hard white light sweeps from the lower-left corner to the upper-right: the left thumb and index finger flare first, the highlight travels along the bottom edge of the frame and up the right index finger, the right hand ignites while the left sinks back into grey stipple, then the light returns to its starting position overhead. Hands hold still. Locked camera.
11.audio: Sound: a slow electric hum sliding in pitch.

11.action: The hands slide apart, the frame widening into a broad rectangle, then a soft white glow blooms inside the frame like a screen lighting up, brightening into a pale luminous panel with drifting dot grain; the hands tighten the frame back around the glow, and the glow fades to black as the fingers hold the small rectangle. Locked camera, top light plus the glow.
11.audio: Sound: a soft electric bloom, a low hum, then a click as it dims.

11.action: The hands tilt the frame together, rotating it fifteen degrees clockwise like a director reframing a shot, hold, then rotate back through level to fifteen degrees counter-clockwise, and finally settle level in the exact starting pose. Locked camera, top light.
11.audio: Sound: a faint creak with each tilt.

11.action: The hands slide apart along the diagonal, the left hand sinking to the bottom-left corner and the right hand rising to the top-right corner, thumbs and index fingers still extended as two corner marks, leaving the whole centre of the frame as clean empty black for a title, and hold. Locked camera, top light.
11.audio: Sound: a soft low room tone.

12.action: The praying hands hold and breathe: the palms press and ease by a millimetre, the fingertips tremble faintly, veins and tendons on the back of the near hand ripple, and the stipple grain on the wrists shimmers. Locked camera, fixed top-left light.
12.audio: Sound: a faint room tone with the softest breath.

12.action: The hands slowly open like a book along the seam of the palms, parting until they face each other a hand's width apart with fingers relaxed, pause, then close again, the palms and fingertips meeting and pressing together until the hands stand in the exact starting prayer pose. One smooth cycle. Locked camera, top-left light.
12.audio: Sound: a soft rustle, then a quiet press of palms.

12.action: After a short hold the joined hands sink straight down along the column of the forearms, fingertips still pointing up, and slide out of the bottom of the frame until only clean black remains. Locked camera, steady top-left light.
12.audio: Sound: a low hum that fades to silence.

12.action: The engraved dots of the hands loosen from the fingertips downward, the pressed fingers thinning into a column of drifting white specks that rise like smoke, then the drift reverses and the specks fall back into fingers, veins and palms until the praying hands stand whole in their exact starting pose. Locked camera.
12.audio: Sound: dry grains hissing, then settling.

12.action: The camera pushes in slowly toward the fingertips, the pressed fingers and the raised veins of the near hand growing large and crisp, the wrists sliding out past the bottom edge, until the fingertips fill the upper frame. The hands hold still. Fixed top-left light.

The camera arcs slowly around the praying hands, a thirty-degree orbit from front toward the right, revealing the far hand behind the near one, the seam of the palms and the thickness of the joined wrists, while the hands stay perfectly still. Top-left light, black void.

A hard white light travels from the top of the frame down to the bottom: the fingertips flare first, the highlight rolls down the back of the near hand across its veins and knuckles, down the wrists, and off the bottom edge, then the light returns to its top-left position. Hands hold still. Locked camera.
12.audio: Sound: a slow electric hum sliding in pitch.

12.action: The palms part slightly and a thin line of white light escapes from the seam between them, growing into a soft glow that spills out between the fingers; the hands open wider and the glow rises from the palms as a cloud of bright drifting dots, then the hands close again and the light is pressed out. Locked camera, top-left light plus the glow.
12.audio: Sound: a soft rising choir-like tone, then a hush.

12.action: The fingers slowly interlace, sliding between each other until the hands are clasped with knuckles up, hold the clasp, then the fingers unlace and the palms press flat together again, tilting slightly left, in the exact starting pose. Locked camera, top-left light.
12.audio: Sound: a soft slide of fingers.

12.action: The joined hands slide down and to the left, shrinking slightly as they retreat along the forearms, and come to rest small in the lower-left of the frame, fingertips still pointing up, leaving the right side and the upper two-thirds as clean empty black for a title. Locked camera, top-left light.
12.audio: Sound: a soft low room tone.
